articles.summary: arXiv:2611.22362v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Complex health conversations require answers grounded in individual information and currently valid evidence. We evaluate health context learning: acquiring, integrating, and applying relevant context during inference with fixed model parameters to answer health questions and respond appropriately to changes in facts, evidence, or task goals. To our knowledge, Chinese-language medical benchmarks have yet to systematically combine explicit contextual difficulties, controlled case variations, and member-specific medical criteria for open-ended answers. We introduce HealthCLBench, comprising 328 controlled clusters, 1,103 cases, and 4,931 rubric criteria across medical consultation and everyday health management. articles.summary: arXiv:2401.10816v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The ability to shape health behaviors of large populations automatically, across wearable types and disease conditions at scale has tremendous potential to improve global health outcomes. We designed and implemented an AI driven platform for digital algorithmic nudging, enabled by a Graph-Neural Network (GNN) based Recommendation System, and granular health behavior data from wearable fitness devices. articles.title: Grand Theft Auto would be a huge TV series – here’s why it will never happen
articles.summary: It is the biggest game of the decade, but there are a billion reasons why GTA shouldn’t be adapted for television. It joins a list of wildly popular titles that won’t see the light of day on streaming platforms You probably aren’t going to see a Grand Theft Auto TV show anytime soon. Speaking on a recent podcast, Strauss Zelnick, the CEO of the game’s parent company Take-Two Interactive, said that a film or television adaptation of GTA would only happen if its team thought that it would “somehow engage and delight our consumers. It’s a high bar to do that. And, of course, there’s always a risk of failure. So we don’t rule it out, but we’re very, very selective.” And, well, good. There are a billion reasons why a small screen version would be a terrible idea. Creatively, the thrill of a GTA game is that no two players have the exact same experience. articles.title: HealthCLBench:Evaluating Context Learning in Health Conversations through Controlled Case Clusters
articles.summary: arXiv:2611.22362v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Complex health conversations require answers grounded in individual information and currently valid evidence. We evaluate health context learning: acquiring, integrating, and applying relevant context during inference with fixed model parameters to answer health questions and respond appropriately to changes in facts, evidence, or task goals. To our knowledge, Chinese-language medical benchmarks have yet to systematically combine explicit contextual difficulties, controlled case variations, and member-specific medical criteria for open-ended answers. We introduce HealthCLBench, comprising 328 controlled clusters, 1,103 cases, and 4,931 rubric criteria across medical consultation and everyday health management.
